tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and the reading sheet. White: cool white; Editorial: ivory; Stationery: laid cream (the laid-line texture is drawn on top, Paper and Night only).

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The glassine layer: code blocks, inline code, search field, the sheet beneath a stacked card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, rules and control outlines on paper and sheet, every theme.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: leads, captions, code comments. At least 5:1 on paper and sheet and at least 4.5:1 on `highlight` (a highlighted code line) in every theme. Stationery Night was raised from #b8a98d (3.74:1 on a highlighted line) after the audit. Never on leather: use `on-accent-soft` there.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Quiet hairlines only: table body rows, header bottom edge. Never text, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The flat offset under a raised control (White keycap, Editorial offset). Decorative, never meaning.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Disabled controls: the text, icon and outline of a control that cannot be used now. A disabled control also differs by shape (no keycap, a dashed outline), never by this grey alone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The voice's house colour, option 1. White: Cobalt marker. Editorial: Rubric red. Stationery: Oxblood leather (a surface, not text). As text it reads on paper at 5:1 or better in White and Editorial.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Reader option 2. White: Signal. Editorial: Blue pencil. Stationery: Bottle-green leather. Swap in for `accent` when the reader picks it.

tokens.name: accent-3
tokens.usage: Reader option 3. White: Graphite (no colour). Editorial: Green ink. Stationery: Navy leather.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (an active toggle, a leather bar, the nav and footer on the desk). Never literal white. In Stationery it is cream: on leather only, never on paper (1.08:1 there).

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on leather: footer links and notes, nested nav levels, TOC sub-items. At least 7:1 on every leather in Paper and Night, 9.8:1 on e-ink. Other voices alias to `ink-soft` (they have no leather).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter band behind `ink` text: link underlay (White), search hits, the current nav item, `hl_lines` in code. Paired with option 1.

tokens.name: highlight-2
tokens.usage: Highlighter paired with `accent-2`.

tokens.name: highlight-3
tokens.usage: Highlighter paired with `accent-3`.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: The reader's hand: links, margin notes, drawn marks, section numerals in White and Editorial. Stationery's pen is blue-black fountain ink, independent of the leather. On paper and sheet at 5:1 or better.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Stationery's text-safe gold on paper: section numerals I. II., labels, table rules, the verified seal. 5:1 on `paper`. Other voices alias it to `ink-soft`.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Flat decorative gold: header stitching, wordmark on leather, the sheet's gilt edge, the active nav tab. On leather only for text; never on paper as text (too light). One flat colour, never a gradient: on e-ink it is G11.

tokens.name: leather-dark
tokens.usage: Stationery header bar (the darker cut of the chosen leather). Other voices alias to `paper`.

tokens.name: wax
tokens.usage: Stationery's wax seal dot in a warning label. Flat; G3 on e-ink.

tokens.name: index-line
tokens.usage: Ruled lines of the Stationery index card behind code (every 28px).

tokens.name: index-red
tokens.usage: The red top rule of the index card, under the code title.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on paper and sheet: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on paper and sheet in every theme. Never on leather or on a cream field: use `focus-on-leather` / `focus-on-cream`.

tokens.name: focus-on-leather
tokens.usage: Focus ring on Stationery leather (header, desk nav, drawer, footer). Flat gold: at least 5.4:1 on all six leather shades, 9.8:1 on the e-ink bar. The pen ring measured 1.01–1.31:1 there.

tokens.name: focus-on-cream
tokens.usage: Focus ring on a cream (`on-accent`) control: the Stationery search field and buttons in the leather header. 13:1 or better. The light Night pen measured 1.46:1 there.

tokens.name: grey-0
tokens.usage: E-ink level G0.

tokens.name: grey-1
tokens.usage: G1 — ink on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-2
tokens.usage: G2 — Stationery leather on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-3
tokens.usage: G3 — wax on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-4
tokens.usage: G4 — ink-soft on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-5
tokens.usage: G5 — Stationery gold on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-6
tokens.usage: G6 — lowest grey allowed for small text on G15.

tokens.name: grey-11
tokens.usage: G11 — rules; gilt on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-12
tokens.usage: G12 — highlighter on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-13
tokens.usage: G13 — glassine tint.

tokens.name: grey-14
tokens.usage: G14 — sheet on e-ink.

tokens.name: grey-15
tokens.usage: G15 — paper on e-ink.

styles.name: ed-display

styles.usage: Running text in Editorial; the first paragraph opens with a rubricated drop cap.

styles.name: ed-label

styles.name: ed-note

styles.name: st-display
styles.usage: Page title in Stationery, italic, over a 3px double `gold` rule.

styles.name: st-section
styles.usage: h2 in Stationery, small caps; inline numeral “I.” italic in `gold`.

styles.name: st-body
styles.sample: XBL then accepts an ABL signed with Qualcomm’s public test keys.
styles.usage: Running text in Stationery (Garamond reads small: +2px over the other voices).

styles.name: st-label
styles.usage: Labels in Stationery: small caps, lowercase, in `gold`.

styles.name: st-note
styles.sample: ❧ ABL is where we come in
styles.usage: Margin notes in fountain-pen `pen`, led by a ❧.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code in every voice. Highlighting by weight (keywords 600) and slant (comments italic), never by colour.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The unit. Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button groups, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter at every width; header padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Admonition padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in the content column.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above an h2.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Stationery sheet padding; minimum touch target.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Column gap between nav and content.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Editorial everything: frames, code, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-paper
tokens.usage: Stationery sheet, cards and index card.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Stationery buttons and search field; White's highlighter swipe.

tokens.name: radius-ui
tokens.usage: White buttons, fields, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: White cards and admonitions.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: White verified sticker; scheme pills.

tokens.name: keycap
tokens.usage: White raised controls and cards: a flat 3px offset beneath a 1.5px ink outline. No blur.

tokens.name: passe-partout
tokens.usage: Editorial frames: a 5px paper gap then a second 1px ink line around admonitions and cards.

tokens.name: offset
tokens.usage: Editorial buttons and pagination cards: a hard 3px offset.

tokens.name: sheet-stack
tokens.usage: Stationery reading sheet on the leather desk: one sheet beneath, soft drop. Flat outline on e-ink.

tokens.name: card-stack
tokens.usage: Stationery cards (admonitions, pagination): two stacked sheets, 3px apart. On e-ink in White and Editorial: the flat 3px `shade` offset under a card.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of running text in every voice.

tokens.name: note-column
tokens.usage: Margin-note column beside content at 1200px and wider; below that, notes sit inline after their paragraph.

tokens.name: nav-column
tokens.usage: Site navigation column.

tokens.name: stroke-keyline
tokens.usage: White: control and card outlines, header bottom.

tokens.name: stroke-dotted
tokens.usage: White: table body rows, nav separators.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Editorial and Stationery rules.

tokens.name: stroke-double
tokens.usage: Editorial header bar and title rule; Stationery title rule in gold.

tokens.name: stroke-stitch
tokens.usage: Stationery gold-thread stitching on leather.
